title: Architecture manifest
description: One manifest of a repository's architecture, read by @goodbones/cli and @goodbones/oxlint. See https://dataquail.github.io/goodbones/architecture-rules/manifest/.

$schema.description: For editors. Ignored by the loader.

defs.description: Named fragments, referenced elsewhere in the manifest as `{ use: "<name>" }`. A fragment may itself contain `use`. Every file's `defs` share one namespace.

Use.description: A reference to a fragment under the top-level `defs`. Replaced by a copy of the fragment before the manifest is decoded; any other key written beside `use` overrides the fragment's key of the same name.

Include.description: A reference to another YAML or JSON file, relative to this one. Replaced by that file's whole value before the manifest is decoded; a list item naming a file that holds a list is spliced in. Nothing may be written beside `include`.
